basis: User authorized approximate GPU test values and unattended B14 continuation. Freeze these values before three new ordinary PILOTs; prior diagnostic runs remain ineligible.
metric: All active WDDM scheduler-node QueuePacket submitted-minus-completed samples plus continuous process-owned ETW queue submission/completion reconstruction. Adapter aliases are not summed.
release_window: Observed leave plus five seconds through requested export; matched completions and context/device destroys, zero loss, no unavailable-to-zero substitution.
limitations: This frozen B14 test condition is specific to the current desktop/driver/SFU/load fingerprints, not a universal product capacity specification.
Kernel scheduler packets are not hardware queue depth. Unknown/hardware-queue schemas, loss, parse errors, reset, timeout and abort fail closed.
32 GiB ETW budget is independent of the existing 32 GiB checkpoint archive; require both budgets plus 8 GiB free reserve before qualification/formal.
PCM 200 ms, ECS 3 Mbps, fixed media load and all prior resource/performance thresholds remain unchanged.
